brandComInfo.introduce:
欧立腾集团（ALTEN Group）于1988年成立于法国巴黎，经过30余年的发展，在全球30多个国家拥有超过42300名员工，为客户提供汽车、通信与媒体、航空、工业、零售与消费、金融等行业的工程咨询服务。

自2012年进入中国以来，欧立腾中国（ALTEN China）目前已在北京、上海、大连、重庆、厦门、深圳设立分公司，业务覆盖全国30多个城市。作为具有市场领先地位企业的技术伙伴，欧立腾立足中国市场，为客户在创新、研发、数字化转型以及IT系统开发策略方面提供支持。

“人力资本”、“工程文化”与“盈利&可持续增长” ，是欧立腾构建可持续发展战略的三个着力点。作为连续10年荣膺“Top Employer”的雇主，我们积极帮助员工提升行业认知、掌握专业技能并充分发挥潜能，勇敢创新，追求梦想。

在欧立腾中国（ALTEN China），我们引入了法国总部成熟的技术管理团队与技能人才培训机制，希望通过灵活、公平的晋升机制，贯穿工作全流程的技能培训，多样化的技术项目机会，简单和谐、包容有爱的职场环境、欧立腾工程师联盟（ALTEN Engineers Alliance, AEA）与各种团建活动，帮助工程师无缝融入，在实现职业发展同时，也能在欧立腾收获成长、友谊与快乐。

As an engineering and technology consulting service provider, founded in 1988 in Paris, France, ALTEN Group now has more than 42,300 employees in over 30 countries, serving major clients in key sectors including Automotive, Communications & Media, Aerospace, Industrial, Retail & Consumer, and Finance for more than 30 years.

Established in 2012, ALTEN China has expanded its projects into 30 cities across China, and offices in Beijing, Shanghai, Dalian, Chongqing, Xiamen and Shenzhen.


As a winner of "Top Employer" for 10 years, ALTEN Group has always stuck to the sustainable development concept of "Human capital development", and helps employees fully achieve their personal growth and career development through flexible & fair promotion mechanisms, skills training, diversified technical project opportunities, simple and harmonious working environment and ALTEN Engineer Alliance (AEA).

jobInfo.postDescription:
In charge of Battery and Power Electronics validation for battery, OBC DCDC and E-motor 
负责电池、OBC、DCDC、电机的电池及电力电子验证
	Define and build validation plan for each dedicated component development: Battery, OBC DCDC, E-motor
	Build Battery and Power Electronics validation referential with different stake holders
	Battery and Power Electronics validation and test bench supplier screening, audit and assessment
	Identify and control of supplier validation plan, push if delay is forecasted and escalate if risk identified, control and verify the realized the tests, check and write test report if requested, synthesis of test compliance
	Support other teams for technical analysis of test issue or failures
	Supplier management until the final acceptance
	Build validation RETEX
	Synthesis and report validation status
	Communicate and coordinate with worldwide technical teams, JV and project teams
	Other tasks assigned by managers 
	定义和构建每个专用组件开发的验证计划;电池，OBC DCDC，电机 
	建立与不同利益相关者的电池和电力电子验证参考 
	电池和电力电子验证和试验台供应商筛选，审核和评估 
	识别和控制供应商验证计划，如果预测延迟，则推动，如果发现风险，则升级，控制和验证已实现的测试，如果需要，检查和编写测试报告;测试符合性的综合 
	支持其他团队对测试问题或失败进行技术分析 
	供应商管理
	合成并报告验证状态 
	与全球技术团队，合资公司和项目团队沟通和协调
	 经理分配的其他任务
	Mechanical, Electrical or vehicle engineering background
	Battery and Power electronics working experience are preferred
	Knowledge requested in mechanical, electrical, thermal, EMC, SW, function and function safety aspects
	Profession experience in automotive field
	Communicate with other departments, and be able to interface with Project team, Joint Ventures, French team and other internal team members.
	Synthesis, adaptability and autonomy
	Excellent teamwork, coordination and communication skills

机械、电气或汽车工程背景 
有电池和电力电子工作经验者优先 
机械、电气、热工、EMC、软件、功能和功能安全方面的知识要求 
汽车领域的专业经验 
与其他部门沟通，能够与项目团队、合资企业、法国团队和其他内部团队成员沟通。
综合、适应能力和自主性 优秀的团队合作、协调和沟通能力
